name: SPACE MARINES: CAPTAIN ON BIKE
description:
Some Space Marine Captains ride to war on Raider‑pattern bikes. This is common among the White Scars and Blood Angels, who prize speed and swift armoured strikes most highly. Sat astride such a rugged steed, Captains can race to wherever they are needed most, bringing their prodigious skill and an arsenal of powerful weapons.

Lead a Thunderous Charge

This multipart plastic kit builds a Captain on Bike, a rapid-response leader for your Space Marines armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. Armed as standard with a heavy bolt pistol, master-crafted power weapon, and the bike's twin bolt rifle, they are a potent force for your front lines.

Your Captain, Your Way

The Captain can be assembled with a master-crafted power weapon, a hard-hitting thunder hammer, or a plasma pistol in their right hand. The base can be assembled with or without a decorative rock, with a leg either planted on the ground or on the bike's foot peg, in which case the bike can also be assembled tilting to the left or the right. You'll find a mounted sword sheath that can be assembled with or without the sword, and a mounted holster with or without a pistol. There are also two helmeted heads and three bare head options to choose from.

Contents:
– 42 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 90mm by 52.5mm Oval Base
– 1 construction guide

This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
